'''''Rho''-class airspeeders''' were a craft created by the [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]] vehicle manufacturer<ref name="Target" /> around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]<ref name="CRB">The [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] indicates that the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] series takes place shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] which corresponds to the date of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] were favored by bush [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] on backwater [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] as their [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpits]] were similar to those in the Empire's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE/LN starfighters]].<ref name="Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Rho''-class was mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook for the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] series.<ref name="Target" />
